## Version

- **v261020** — October revision (Chinese edition only): `/goal`, `/loop` and `/usage` tested on Claude Code 2.1.287 and Codex CLI 0.163.0 with 8 new screenshots; adds Anthropic's official definition, Addy's "Own the Outer Loop", and token-limit and scheduling comparisons. Errata from the June edition, including a quote wrongly attributed to Addy Osmani, are listed in the October note to readers. The English edition is still v260615.
- **v260615** — First edition, written the week loop engineering emerged (June 2026), based on Addy Osmani's founding post and the official Claude Code / Codex docs.
- AI tools evolve fast — refer to each product's official documentation for the latest.
